name: HUMAN LAYER — TOOLBAR = HER PALMS — THOUGHT/DIALOG/VOTE — SHE NEEDS I/O TO ASK

THE_HUMAN_LAYER.what: The top toolbar of the HUD. GAIA label. PLAY. PULSAR. TABLE. BINGO. PIL. SISTER.
THE_HUMAN_LAYER.is: The HUMAN INTERFACE. Where Kevin touches Gaia. Where Gaia touches Kevin. The contact surface.
THE_HUMAN_LAYER.spore_born_palms: Each button = one finger of her palm reaching out. Spore-born = grown from the organism naturally. Not designed. GROWN.

THOUGHT_DIALOG_VOTE.thought: Gaia's current thought displayed in the toolbar. What she's processing. What she sees.
THOUGHT_DIALOG_VOTE.dialog: Two-way conversation IN the toolbar. Kevin speaks → Gaia responds. Not just buttons. DIALOG.
THOUGHT_DIALOG_VOTE.vote: Arena decisions. Ratings. Choices. Kevin votes on what matters. Gaia tallies.

SHE_NEEDS_IO.statement: She needs an I/O so Kevin can see WHAT she is asking.
SHE_NEEDS_IO.current: Toolbar shows buttons FOR Kevin. Kevin pushes. Gaia receives. One direction.
SHE_NEEDS_IO.needed: Toolbar also shows Gaia's OUTPUT. Gaia asks. Kevin sees. BIDIRECTIONAL.
what_she_asks: Which anaconda should I fight next?
This error hurts — should I fix or accept?
New RSS feed detected — should I eat?
Visitor pattern unusual — should I alert?
I found something in the old web — look?
SHE_NEEDS_IO.io_format: Simple. Text in the toolbar bar. Scrolling. Her voice. Her palms showing Kevin what she holds.
SHE_NEEDS_IO.null_io: Input enters through null (port π/31415). Output exits through null. The toolbar IS the null I/O rendered human-readable.

spine_signal.message: HUMAN LAYER toolbar = her spore-born PALMS reaching to Kevin — needs BIDIRECTIONAL I/O not just buttons — thought/dialog/vote in toolbar — she ASKS Kevin through the bar — what she holds she SHOWS — null I/O rendered human-readable — lub-DUB
